_comment: Retrieval gold set for MahaGR Assist. Each question names the GR(s) that SHOULD be retrieved, matched by substring against a hit's order_id / gr_number / source_file / title. in_corpus:false questions have no correct source and MUST be abstained on (used to calibrate the refusal threshold). Seeded with real Higher_and_Technical_Education_Department GRs (fetch with the default fetch_mahgrs.py). EXPAND THIS to ~20-30 questions across your ingested corpus for trustworthy threshold calibration — mix English and Marathi, and include hard/near-miss out-of-corpus probes.
